text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... We definitely took too much from 
the snack catering, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I have to do something... Before I end 
up causing trouble for Tomakomai as an 
unhealthy local idol...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, despite trying all kinds of 
remedies, the acne just wouldn't clear 
up...
